source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"A single factor alone, without any additional classification components built into the overall system","B":"Mainly the client's age and general health status, rather than characteristics of the tumor itself","C":"Tumor size/extent (T), lymph node involvement (N), and presence of distant metastasis (M)","D":"A system generally considered to carry fairly little established clinical use in cancer care today"}}
source_row.rationale: The TNM staging system classifies cancer based on tumor size/extent (T), regional lymph node involvement (N), and presence of distant metastasis (M), providing a standardized framework used to guide treatment planning and communicate prognosis across different cancer types.
